{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''poacher''' and '''smuggler''' was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime prior to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the poacher, in an attempt to pay of his debts for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], kidnapped four [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. However, when the poacher tried to give the Yuzzem to Jabba, the crime lord was infuriated and dropped the poacher and his catch into his [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit. The poacher was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the rancor.
